name: Matred
overview: Matred is a female biblical figure known primarily as the mother of Mehetabel. Her mention is brief and limited to her maternal role, with no tribal affiliation or additional personal details recorded in Scripture.
namesAndTitles: The name Matred appears once in Genesis 36:39 and is noted to possibly mean 'spear.' This proper name does not have a divine origin but reflects a typical Hebrew personal name of the period.
familyAndRelationships: Matred is explicitly identified as the mother of Mehetabel and is also linked as the mother of Mezahab. These relationships are clearly stated in Genesis 36:39, with no further family connections documented.
scriptureSignificance: While Matred's presence in Scripture is limited, her significance lies in her role as the mother of Mehetabel, situating her within the genealogical records of Genesis. This connection contributes to the broader biblical narrative by preserving the lineage details important for understanding the descendants mentioned in the text.
